name: FireworksRecipes
description: Fireworks 配方目录（manifest 驱动）。每条 = 一个可一键安装并发布到 DGX Spark 集群的模型配方；nodes 为固定拓扑（发布时须恰好匹配，模型参数按此调优）。
description_en: Fireworks recipe catalog (manifest-driven). Each entry is a model recipe you can install and publish to a DGX Spark cluster with one click; nodes declare a fixed topology (publish must match exactly, model params are tuned for it).

recipes.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的专属镜像 + 双节点 TP=2 vLLM 服务（GB10 定向 overlay、InstantTensor 快速加载、dspark 投机、DS-MLA 量化 KV、1M 上下文）。固定 2 节点拓扑。
recipes.description_en: Dedicated-image 2-node TP=2 vLLM serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (GB10-targeted overlay, InstantTensor fast load, dspark speculation, quantized DS-MLA KV, 1M context). Fixed 2-node topology.

recipes.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 双节点 TP=2 DSpark 服务（Anemll 分发镜像，FlashInfer b12x + dspark 投机，NVFP4 DS-MLA）。固定 2 节点拓扑。
recipes.description_en: 2-node TP=2 DSpark serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash (Anemll distribution image, FlashInfer b12x + dspark speculation, NVFP4 DS-MLA). Fixed 2-node topology.
